name: Mongolian People's Republic
native: Бүгд Найрамдах Монгол Ард Улс (Bügd Nairamdakh Mongol Ard Uls)

predecessors.name: Great Mongol State (Bogd Khanate of Mongolia)
predecessors.text: the whole of Outer Mongolia: the constitution 'adopted by the first Great Khural in November 1924, proclaimed the Mongolian People's Republic' (infobox: Predecessor Bogd Khanate of Mongolia)

successors.name: Mongolia
successors.text: the whole country: the 1992 constitution 'entering into force in February' created the State of Mongolia

ledger.x: 26 November 1924: the Mongolian People's Republic is proclaimed.
ledger.cpn: Great Mongol State (Bogd Khanate of Mongolia)

ledger.x: May 1939: fighting on the Khalkhin Gol begins.
16 September 1939: ceasefire on the Khalkhin Gol.
August 1945: Mongolian cavalry enter Inner Mongolia with the Red Army.
5 June 1947: Mongolian troops attack at Baitag Bogd.
Early July 1947: the Mongols give the land back.

wars.name: Battles of Khalkhin Gol
wars.outcome: Soviet-Mongolian victory; ceasefire agreed 15 September (effective 16 September 1939); 'Status quo ante bellum; enforcement of border claims in accordance with the Soviet and Mongolian interpretation'.

wars.name: Soviet invasion of Manchuria (Mongolian cavalry in Inner Mongolia)
wars.outcome: The Soviet-Mongolian Cavalry-Mechanized Group took Dolon Nur and Kalgan from Mengjiang; fighting ended 2 September 1945; the Red Army withdrew by 3 May 1946.

wars.name: Battle of Baitag Bogd (Beitashan incident)
wars.outcome: Infobox result 'Status quo ante bellum'; the lands the Mongols had occupied were returned to China in early July 1947; the frontier was divided in the 1962 demarcation.

certainty.note: The frontier with China was undemarcated and disputed (Baitag Bogd 1947, the Khalkhin Gol line 1939); the Soviet frontier follows older treaty lines that were not opened, so it is treated as the era's level.
The China-Mongolia frontier was delimited by the treaty of 26 December 1962, demarcated 1963-1964 and fixed by a final treaty with maps on 30 June 1964; 'the border has remained where it is'.
